Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

BenchFlow SkillsBench · documents: The paper acknowledges missing length-matched context controls, limited model/harness coverage, nondeterminism and contamination risks when interpreting skill gains.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.skillsbench.causal-and-generalization-limits

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Paired improvements on selected skill-dependent container tasks do not establish a universal causal benefit, transfer to GUI/multi-agent workflows or performance of every released skill.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

BenchFlow SkillsBench · documents: SkillsBench compares the same agent/model with and without reusable task skills; the original paper averages five binary-reward trials per task over a fixed 84-task denominator.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.skillsbench.paired-skill-protocol

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The 7,308 valid trajectories include ordinary failures and timeouts but exclude infrastructure/runtime errors; self-generated skills were evaluated only for five of seven configurations.
